notes: The chain ends at Mujahid, who is named after «عن» and whose exegesis is the saying.
«وقال عطاء قال ابن عباس نسخت هذه الآية» is a second saying with its own isnad (Ata from Ibn Abbas): two sayings in one report (rule 11), so it is not written as a route here.
«زعم ذلك عن مجاهد» restates the same name later in the report and is not a second link.
